system: Port of Nevelsk (with Kuril sections), harbour master
title: Nevelsk and Kuril sections: call port control 2 NM before the section limit
authority: Harbour master of the seaport of Nevelsk (Невельск-портконтроль; Северо-Курильск-портконтроль etc.), FGBU AMP of Sakhalin, Kuril Islands and Kamchatka
applies_to: All ships bound for the sections of the port: Nevelsk, Severo-Kurilsk, Kurilsk, Yuzhno-Kurilsk, Malokurilsk.
applies_quote: 25. Суда, следующие в морской порт, за две морские мили до пересечения границ участков акватории устанавливают связь на каналах связи ОВЧ, указанных в сведениях о каналах связи очень высокой частоты, используемых в морском порту, предусмотренных в Приложении N 3 к Обязательным постановлениям (далее - Сведения о каналах связи).

when.text: Arrival and departure information to the harbour master through www.portcall.marinet.ru (p. 12). Times per the General Rules: 120 to 72 hours before arrival, confirm 48 to 24 hours before; arrival application within 4 hours of first anchoring or mooring; departure application 4 hours before departure (ru-general-prearrival). From a foreign port the entry permission must also be agreed with the FSB (ru-entry-fsb-permission).
2 NM before crossing the limit of a port section, call on the Appendix 3 channels (Nevelsk: Невельск-портконтроль, calling 16, working 11) (p. 25).
Emergency information on CH 16 (p. 61). Dangerous goods information through portcall.marinet.ru (p. 53).

lines.text: Maximum present draught and air draught
Kind of cargo, dangerous cargo on board
Defects of ship equipment and other limits that affect safe navigation

format_note: Report items from General Rules p. 29.

area.zone: Port sections; their limits are in the regulations' appendices and not copied here
